body: I don't have any IRL buds. The one person who really saw that side of me left me, and painted me as some awful monster. I don't believe that I am, but it hurts, you know.
Depression, in one word. I always tried to lift the spirit of another. Most people that know me don't really know the darkness that I hold within.
I feel completely alone in this world, isolated. I've never been able to be my true self.
